checks.detail: All25 package tests passed. The new switch regression first reproduced400 before the change. Native routes now omit only dual-marked, purely opaque adapter reasoning while retaining visible messages, tool history, native ciphertext, nonopaque reasoning and the original input. Existing same-model Messages thinking/tool roundtrips continue to pass.

limitations: Offline evidence only; no real user conversation, credentials, signed thinking payloads or upstream account responses are published.
This is not universal model-switch compatibility. Native-to-Messages, cross-Claude-model encrypted state and unknown provider ciphertext are not normalized.
Only the outbound native request is normalized. Stored conversations are not edited, and no decrypted thinking is sent to another provider.
Earlier evidence retains its original bytes as historical; this record does not promote prior live or GUI observations to fresh execution.
